summary: Regression of the change in thermal melting temperature (ΔTm) caused by a single-point mutation.
what_it_measures: ΔTm (°C) of a point mutant relative to wild type, standardized (`dtm_standardized`). This is a mutation-delta task: the feature is the mutant-minus-wild-type embedding.
assay_method: Experimentally measured thermostability (Tm) of single-point mutants, manually curated in FireProtDB from literature and lab data.
provenance: FireProtDB split into ΔTm and ΔΔG subsets by non-null field; mutant sequences are built by applying the substitution to the wild-type sequence.
when_to_use: Protein-engineering task for stabilizing mutations; tests whether embedding deltas capture the effect of point mutations on thermal stability.
caveats: Small, imbalanced, and family-biased; single-point only. Mutant−WT deltas require equal-length sequences. Standardized target (MAE in standardized units).

citations.title: FireProtDB: database of manually curated protein stability data
